en.headline: First electric coach starts Hong Kong–Macau runs via the Bridge
en.dek: Operator One Bus put a 52-seat battery coach on two daily crossings from Saturday, saying energy costs could fall by about half versus diesel.
body: Cross-border operator One Bus said its first electric coach entered service on Saturday on the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge route between Kowloon and Macau.

The company said the 52-seat vehicle uses a blade battery and a German-made drive motor, can recharge to about 80 percent in roughly 100 minutes, and has a claimed range of more than 740 kilometres on a full charge. For now it is the only electric vehicle in the fleet and is scheduled for two daily round trips, starting on the Mid-Autumn public holiday.

Director Cham Yuen said running costs should be lower than diesel. He estimated that if a diesel coach used 10,000 dollars of fuel, the electric equivalent would cost about 5,000 dollars, a saving of about 40 to 50 percent. Services pick up in Jordan and run to casino-hotel stops in Macau. The operator offered a limited buy-outbound, complimentary-return promotion on specified inaugural departures.

zh.headline: 港澳一號首部電動巴今日經大橋往返澳門
zh.dek: 營辦商周六起以52座位電動旅巴行走港珠澳大橋紐，暫每日兩班，估計燃料開支較柴油車低四至五成。
body: 跨境巴士營辦商港澳一號表示，旗下首部電動旅遊巴已於周六投入服務，經港珠澳大橋往來九龍及澳門。
公司指新車有52個座位，採用刀片電池及德國驅動摩打，約100分鐘可充至八成電，滿電續航聲稱超過740公里。目前車隊只有這一輛電車，中秋節翌日公眾假期起每日提供兩個往返班次。
董事湛源表示，改用電車預計可節省約四至五成燃料開支，以柴油車用1萬元油費計算，電車約需5,000元。路線由佐敦開出，抵達澳門多個娛樂場酒店站。營辦商為指定首航班次推出限時買去程送回程優惠。
